data.title: Fu Shek Financial Holdings Reports Interim Results for Six Months Ended September 2026
data.description:

data.title: Western Metallica Extends Exclusivity for Nueva Celti Copper Project
data.description:
An announcement from Western Metallica Resources Corp. ( (TSE:WMS) ) is now available.

Western Metallica said the exclusivity period under its agreement with AJAX Resources for the Nueva Celti Copper Project in Andalusia, Spain, has been extended to December 18, 2026. The agreement gives AJAX an exclusive and irrevocable option to acquire 100% of Western Metallica’s Spanish subsidiary that owns the project.

Subject to conditions precedent, revised consideration for the proposed acquisition is US$145,000; if those conditions are not met, previously announced terms will prevail. TSXV conditional approval has been received, with closing still subject to conditions including shareholder approval.

data.title: Kowloon Development Agrees to HK$585 Million Rideon Disposal
data.description:
An update from Kowloon Development Co ( (HK:0034) ) is now available.

Kowloon Development Company Limited announced that its wholly owned subsidiary agreed on 27 November 2026 to sell 40% of Rideon Limited and assign its related sale loan to a purchaser for HK$585 million. The consideration comprises HK$1 for the shares and HK$584,999,999 for the loan, which was HK$800,632,953 as of 30 September 2026; 10% was payable on signing and the balance on completion.

Upon completion, the vendor will cease to own shares in Rideon. The transaction is discloseable because the applicable percentage ratio exceeds 5% but is below 25%, requiring reporting and announcement while remaining exempt from circular and shareholder approval requirements.

data.title: Plastikkart General Assembly Approves 2025 Accounts and Capital Increase
data.description:
An update from Plastikkart Akilli Kart Iletisim Sistemleri Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. ( (TR:PKART) ) is now available.

The company’s 2025 Annual General Assembly was held on 17 July 2026, with the 2025 financial statements and operating results approved. Members of the Board of Directors were released from liability, and the selection of the independent audit firm was approved.

The meeting also accepted an amendment to increase paid-in capital from TRY 22,750,000 to TRY 300,000,000 using internal resources and discussed dividend payment. The meeting decisions were registered by the İstanbul Trade Registry Directorate on 27 November 2026.

data.title: China New Energy Updates Plan for 2025 Audit Disclaimer
data.description:
China New Energy ( (HK:1156) ) has shared an announcement.

The company said material uncertainty over the Group’s ability to continue as a going concern led its auditor to issue a disclaimer of opinion on the consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025. It reported that it had formulated an action plan covering financing, capital management and measures to improve its financial position and address the underlying factors behind the disclaimer.

The first placing, completed on 15 July 2026, involved 117,951,779 shares and generated net proceeds of approximately HK$19.59 million; the company reallocated HK$9.59 million to general working capital and HK$10 million to new subsidiaries and expansion. A second placing of up to 117,951,779 shares at HK$0.161 each was disclosed as conditional on listing approval and other conditions, with its long-stop date extended to 14 December 2026.

data.title: Mediaco Holding Announces Second Board Director Resignation
data.description:
Mediaco Holding ( (MDIA) ) has provided an update.

On November 23, 2026, Deborah A. McDermott resigned from MediaCo Holding Inc.’s board and all committees, effective immediately, after serving as a director since November 2019 and holding board, compensation committee and audit committee roles; she said the decision would allow more time for other commitments. On November 24, 2026, Jacqueline Hernandez likewise resigned after more than two years on the board, citing potential conflicts from other business initiatives; both resignations were unrelated to disagreements with the company’s operations, policies or practices.
